actionResult.summary: 已完成 C1 OpenSpec 1.7 Thin Integration Explore：真实验证 OpenSpec 1.7.0 已提供 status/instructions/apply/archive/validate 等 structured JSON authority，但当前 Flowkit 尚无 production consumer且多处硬编码 openspec/changes path。关键 contract gap 是 built-in spec-driven 只管理 proposal/specs/design/tasks 四个 planning artifacts，而 Flowkit 仍把 explore.md 与 verification.md 作为 formal Change facts；project-local custom schema虽可手工扩展 explore/verification，但 schema command仍 experimental，且 verification 作为普通 artifact node会落在 pre-Apply planning graph，不能直接表达 post-Apply Change Verification。因此 Proposal 必须先冻结 artifact authority split、A1 metadata schema seam、structured path→safe logical ref、OpenSpec 1.7 version/invocation/timeout/Windows launcher、validation与archive operation result contract；C1保持 thin invoke/parse/normalize bridge，不复制 OpenSpec state machine。
